note: Media Qualtrics adds a Media Remote field formatter (plugin id media_qualtrics, label 'Remote Media - Qualtrics') for string fields that renders an allowed-host Qualtrics URL as an iframe. Its only persistent state is the simple config object media_qualtrics.settings.allowed_hosts (sequence of https:// domains, shipped default ['https://qualtrics.com']); the settings form is at /admin/config/media/qualtrics (route media_qualtrics.allowed_hosts_settings, permission 'administer qualtrics allowed hosts'). It depends on media_remote and, if csp is installed, appends the allowed hosts to frame-src. All medium/hard cases are grounded in this local config object - no live Qualtrics API calls and no field/entity creation.

evals.prompt: In Drupal, how does the media_qualtrics module display a Qualtrics survey URL that an editor has entered? What kind of field does it work on and what is the field formatter called?
evals.expected_output: It provides a field formatter (plugin id media_qualtrics, label 'Remote Media - Qualtrics') for plain string fields, built on media_remote. A string field value holding a Qualtrics URL is rendered as an auto-resizing <iframe class="qualtrics-embed-container"> via the media_qualtrics theme/template, with a fallback link.

evals.prompt: The media_qualtrics module only renders survey URLs from approved hosts. Where do I configure the list of allowed Qualtrics hosts, and in which config object is it stored?
evals.expected_output: Configure it at /admin/config/media/qualtrics (route media_qualtrics.allowed_hosts_settings, permission 'administer qualtrics allowed hosts'), one host per line. It is stored in the media_qualtrics.settings config object under allowed_hosts (a sequence of https:// domains; default ['https://qualtrics.com']).

evals.prompt: What module does media_qualtrics depend on, and what does it do automatically when the Content Security Policy (CSP) module is enabled?
evals.expected_output: It depends on media_remote (the formatter extends MediaRemoteFormatterBase). When the csp module is enabled, an event subscriber on csp.policy_alter appends the configured allowed hosts to the frame-src directive on non-admin routes so the Qualtrics iframes are not blocked.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has media_qualtrics configured with an extra allowed Qualtrics host beyond the default. Inspect the live configuration and list all hosts that are currently allowed for Qualtrics embeds.
evals.expected_output: The media_qualtrics.settings config object lists allowed_hosts = ['https://qualtrics.com', 'https://mq-known.qualtrics.example.com']; read it with `drush cget media_qualtrics.settings allowed_hosts`.

evals.prompt: media_qualtrics on this site is configured to permit several Qualtrics hosts. Inspect the live configuration and state whether embeds from https://eu.mqknown.example.com are currently allowed, and how many hosts are configured in total.
evals.expected_output: Yes - https://eu.mqknown.example.com is in media_qualtrics.settings allowed_hosts, which contains three hosts: https://qualtrics.com, https://eu.mqknown.example.com, https://survey.mqknown.example.com.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, allow the custom Qualtrics vanity domain https://survey.mqtask.example.com to be embedded via media_qualtrics, keeping the existing default host too. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
evals.expected_output: Add 'https://survey.mqtask.example.com' to media_qualtrics.settings allowed_hosts (e.g. edit at /admin/config/media/qualtrics or `drush cset`/config API), so allowed_hosts contains both https://qualtrics.com and https://survey.mqtask.example.com.

evals.prompt: Lock down media_qualtrics on this site so that the ONLY host allowed for Qualtrics embeds is https://only.mqtask.example.com. Remove any other hosts. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set media_qualtrics.settings allowed_hosts to exactly ['https://only.mqtask.example.com'] (replace the whole sequence).
